title: The Broken Prank: A Tangle of Lies and Antique Gold
motive_summary: Reputational Damage/Financial Ruin via Stolen Artifact
overview_text: The body of Marcus Bell was found slumped against a stack of forgotten crates in the dusty back room of the Industrial Exchange. The air smelled faintly of wet concrete and old spices. A single, ornate cufflink—the kind that matches the description of the stolen antique's rightful owner—lay near the victim's outstretched hand, amidst scattered remnants of flash powder used for the prank's failed climax. It was Nadia Cole who stumbled upon the scene while searching for a specific ledger kept in the Nadia's Flat. The weapon, a heavy, ornamental brass paperweight identified as Brass till weight, showed no signs of forced entry or struggle besides the faint smear on its base.
